DeveloperPlans.title: Store plans
DeveloperPlans.subtitle: Exclusive to accounts whose database record has isPlatformOwner = true. The selected plan is applied to upcoming charges and stored in the database.
DeveloperPlans.standardDescription: Standard plan: 8% per transaction, with no fixed monthly fee.
DeveloperPlans.recoveryDescription: Additional surcharge of up to 7 percentage points over the Standard or Pro base plan. It stays active even when the administrator changes plans until the configured amount (ARS 200,000 by default) is recovered.
DeveloperPlans.proDescription: Fixed ARS 75,000 monthly fee plus 2% per transaction.
DeveloperPlans.recoveryTargetHelp: Defaults to ARS 200,000. Adjust it for the work delivered; the additional surcharge of up to 7 points is capped at the outstanding balance and is not lost when switching plans.
DeveloperPlans.targetBelowProgress: The new target cannot be lower than the amount already recovered plus amounts reserved by active checkouts.
DeveloperPlans.monthlyBillingManual: The administrator must pay the first month from /dashboard when activating Pro. Monthly renewal is paid from the dashboard; no automatic recurring debit is set up.
DeveloperPlans.updated: The plan was updated. Upcoming charges will use the selected settings.
DeveloperPlans.invalidPlan: The requested plan could not be understood.
DeveloperPlans.feeDefinition: The commission is calculated on the ARS product subtotal before tax and excludes shipping. The recovery plan charges the 8% base plus up to an additional 7%, capped at the remaining ARS 200,000 target. Recovery amounts reserved by active checkouts count toward the cap.
DeveloperPlans.proMustPayFromDashboard: Pro requires a confirmed ARS 75,000 payment from the administrator dashboard. It cannot be activated manually here.
DeveloperPlans.goToDashboard: Go to admin dashboard to pay
DeveloperPlans.proExpiredHint: The Pro fee has expired. Standard commission applies until renewal, plus any outstanding customization surcharge.

orders.question: Where can I see my orders?
orders.answer: Sign in and open “Order history”. You will find your purchases and the status currently recorded for each order.

payment.question: What should I do if a payment fails or stays pending?
payment.answer: Check the order status in “Order history” before trying to pay again. If the status is unclear or you see a charge on your payment method, contact us with the order number; never share full card details.

cancel.question: Can I cancel a purchase?
cancel.answer: The cancellation option is available while an order is still pending. Once preparation starts or a shipment exists, the store no longer allows cancellation from order history. Contact us with the order number if you need help.

delivery.question: How do I update my delivery address?
delivery.answer: Open “My account” and save your updated details. For an order that has already been placed, changing your account details does not guarantee that an in-progress shipment will be updated; contact us as soon as possible.

tracking.question: Where can I find shipment tracking?
tracking.answer: Open “Order history” and view the order details. If tracking is available for the shipment, the carrier and the relevant link or code will appear there.

security.question: What information should I include when contacting support?
security.answer: Describe the issue and include your account email and order number, if applicable. Never send your password, authentication codes or the full number of a payment card.

contact.title: Still need help?
contact.description: Fill out the form and your message will be sent through the store’s contact channel. Explain what happened and include your order number if you have already purchased.
contact.privacyNote: For your safety, do not share passwords, login codes or full payment-card details.

StorefrontLifecycle.title: Storefront status
StorefrontLifecycle.openDescription: The storefront is published and accepts new purchases.
StorefrontLifecycle.closedDescription: The public storefront is hidden and new purchases are blocked. Existing orders, payments, fulfillment and deliveries continue normally.
StorefrontLifecycle.closeDialogTitle: Are you sure you want to close the storefront?
StorefrontLifecycle.closeDialogDescription: The storefront will no longer be public and the system will block new orders. Products, customers, orders, payments and shipping details will not be deleted. Orders already created will continue processing: initiated payments, fulfillment and deliveries in transit will not be cancelled. Closing does not reverse payments already confirmed or fees from orders already accepted. No new plan renewals will be initiated; if a Pro checkout is pending, the system will try to cancel it before confirming closure.
StorefrontLifecycle.reopenDialogTitle: Do you want to republish the storefront?
StorefrontLifecycle.reopenDialogDescription: The storefront will become visible again and accept new purchases. Orders and history remain intact; the plan in effect when you reopen will apply.
StorefrontLifecycle.closeFailed: The storefront could not be closed.
StorefrontLifecycle.planCheckoutCancelFailed: The pending Pro checkout could not be cancelled. The storefront remains open to avoid a possible later charge. Please retry.

StorefrontLifecycle.reopenFailed: The storefront could not be republished.
StorefrontLifecycle.unexpectedError: An error occurred. The status change was not confirmed.
StorefrontLifecycle.proChargeInProgress: A Pro subscription payment is in progress. Complete or resolve it before closing the storefront.
